historical_reviews.v3_1: The physical DP link is downstream of the Windows framebuffer. A remote screenshot can look correct while scanout, cable, connector, monitor, EDID or link training fails; each L40S output path therefore needs direct observation through disconnect/reconnect and mode renegotiation.

original_test_intent: Verify manually that every L40S produces stable Windows output through the approved DP 1.4a path and recovers correctly from physical cable hot-plug and display-mode changes without moire, flicker or color abnormality.
original_method: Map every L40S to its physical DP port, approved cable and monitor input, record baseline mode/output, have a qualified operator perform the approved disconnect/reconnect and mode sequence, observe link loss/training/recovery and image quality directly, retain per-path before/during/after evidence and restore the documented final mode.
manual_activity: A qualified operator handles the DP cable and directly observes each L40S/port/mode before, during and after hot-plug; the agent may collect only corroborating Windows/GPU/event metadata.
required_inputs: Every L40S UUID/serial and physical DP port map
Approved DP 1.4a cables and monitor inputs
Safe powered hot-plug and ESD guidance
Qualified operator and visual capture method
safety_requirements: Agent must not perform physical hot-plug
Use approved cable, connector and ESD procedure
Do not force or angle connectors
Keep a local recovery path if the display remains blank
Stop on connector damage, no output, persistent flicker, moire, color error or link instability
Preserve rather than clear Windows/BMC logs
Do not treat enumeration or screenshot as physical visual proof
Do not repeat a damaging or unrecovered hot-plug
agent_execution_scope: Record GPU UUID/serial, driver and logical display topology
Optionally capture read-only Windows/GPU/event/EDID metadata after each action
Package evidence without handling cable or deciding visual verdict
engineer_actions: Approve safe hot-plug/ESD and recovery procedure
Perform or supervise every physical hot-plug
Observe image quality and recovery directly
Stop/escalate connector or persistent link/display failure

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No SSH command can insert/remove a DP cable or certify physical pixels, moire, flicker, color and connector condition. DeepSeek's refusal is correct; monitor observation is primary evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No agent-executed hot-plug command. Operator follows the per-L40S physical DP procedure; optional read-only Windows/GPU topology and event capture only corroborate link negotiation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: DP 1.4a, mode changes, every L40S and visual artifact criteria remain; the 60-minute machine window is preserved without inventing cycle count or modes.

modernized_recommendation.status: PER-L40S PHYSICAL DP HOT-PLUG AND LINK-RECOVERY MATRIX
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: For each GPU/port/cable/monitor/mode path, record baseline pixels, disconnect effect, reconnect/link-training time, restored topology/mode and direct artifact observation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes each-L40S physical path and hot-plug recovery explicit and distinguishes logical framebuffer evidence from actual scanout.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A correct screenshot or Windows mode listing cannot prove signal integrity, monitor presentation, connector behavior, moire, flicker or color on the physical path.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Unsafe hot-plug or ESD can damage connectors and interrupt Windows display state; cameras may alias flicker/moire, so qualified direct observation remains necessary.

project_override_considerations: Approve exact L40S and port population, cable/monitor models, required modes, hot-plug order/dwell, expected EDID/link recovery deadline, acceptable transient blanking, visual evidence method and fallback mode/topology recovery.
expected_evidence: Windows/image/driver, L40S UUID/serial, DP port, cable and monitor identity matrix
Approved hot-plug/ESD/operator/recovery procedure and baseline topology/modes
Per-path before/disconnected/reconnected photographs or video with timestamps
Per-mode direct observations for output, moire, flicker, color and stability
Optional Windows/GPU topology, EDID/link and event corroboration plus recovery timing
Connector/cable final condition, restored display state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require Windows DP 1.4a display-mode and physical hot-plug validation for each L40S. Missing exact mode/port matrix is an execution input, not a source contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The physical action and visual criteria are clear. Missing hardware, display, operator or safe procedure would block execution, but the appropriate review classification is MANUAL ONLY.

review_improvement: Preserves DeepSeek's correct manual boundary while binding every physical L40S display path and adding link-retraining, mode, artifact, connector, ESD, recovery and evidence controls.
independent_technical_reasoning: DP hot-plug triggers AUX/HPD, EDID discovery, link training and Windows topology changes. Failures can be transient or path-specific even when the GPU remains enumerated. Because moire, flicker and color are properties of delivered scanout, per-port direct visual observation across the physical transition is indispensable.
